name: HIGHCAST-unknown-refused
old: export const castOverWater = (at, surfaceY) => surfaceY != null && Number.isFinite(surfaceY) && at[1]
new: export const castOverWater = (at, surfaceY) => (surfaceY == null || Number.isFinite(surfaceY)) && at[1]
note: ground not built refuses the cast: a deck over a streaming pixel stops fishing

name: HIGHCAST-infinite-refused
old: export const castOverWater = (at, surfaceY) => surfaceY != null && Number.isFinite(surfaceY) && at[1]
new: export const castOverWater = (at, surfaceY) => surfaceY != null && at[1]
note: a surface read as -Infinity refuses every cast
